sceneDescription: Isikhungo simele indawo ye-Helia yalesi siphequluli. Amanodi aluhlaza ngokukhanyayo okwamanje axhunywe kusiphequluli futhi anomugqa oya phakathi nendawo. Ama-Violet node atholwe umzila wesiphequluli kodwa awaxhunyiwe. Amanodi egolide ayizixhumanisi ezivulekile ezibikwe i-Kubo daemon ehlukene yendawo; azikona ukuxhumana kwesiphequluli futhi azinawo umugqa oya kulesi sikhungo. Izinkanyezi ezifile ze-slate zigcina umlando onqanyuliwe, futhi ulayini wabo wobufakazi ususwa kuphela ngemva kokunqanyulwa. Ibanga ukusuka kumamephu amaphakathi akalwe ukubambezeleka; ontanga abangalinganiswanga bahlala emzileni ongaphandle, futhi amaqembu e-engeli ezokuthutha ezibhekiwe. Izinkanyezi ezingemuva ezihlobisa azimele ontanga. I-orbit yangaphandle ethambile imaka inkambu ye-Kubo engenisiwe futhi ayilona uxhumano. Unqenqema lokudlulisela luvela kuphela uma i-ID yokudlulisela ikhona kusethi yontanga ebhekiwe; i-topology yontanga-kuya-kontanga ayikaze icatshangwe. Sebenzisa isihloli sontanga ukuze uthole ulwazi olufanayo ngendlela yombhalo.
fallbackBody: Le divayisi ayikwazanga ukudala umongo ovikelekile we-WebGL. Okubonwa bukhoma kwe-Helia kuhlala kutholakala ngomhloli wontanga.
